newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish Sept y/y industrial growth falls to 1.9pct.
newsitem.headline: Turkish Sept y/y industrial growth falls to 1.9pct.

text.p: Turkish industry grew by 1.9 year on year percent in September, down from 5.9 percent in the same 1995 month, the State Insititute of Statistics said on Wednesday.

It said manufacturing sector growth was only 0.1 percent compared to 6.3 percent in September 1995. The metal industry recorded the highest growth with 35.6 percent in September against a shrinkage of 17 percent in the same 1995 month.
The mining industry's growth was 23.6 percent in September, compared to a shrinkage of 4.3 percent a year ago.
The total industrial growth was 5.5 percent in the first nine months of this year against 8.3 percent in the same period in 1995.
